Who We Are
Ontic provides software that helps corporate and government security teams identify threats, assess risk, and respond faster to keep people and organizations safe. Its AI-powered Connected Intelligence Platform unifies security operations and data into a centralized system of record, enabling organizations to conduct risk assessments, protect against workplace violence, and manage threats and incidents more efficiently. Fortune 500 companies and federal agencies rely on Ontic to support security programs such as executive protection, threat intelligence, and corporate investigations. Learn more at ontic.ai or follow us on LinkedIn.
Who You Are
As an Associate DevOps Engineer at Ontic, you will join our growing engineering team to help bridge the gap between development and operations. This is an entry-level role designed for a motivated graduate to learn the ropes of maintaining high-level security and reliability for our cloud-based services.
You will support our team in cloud initiatives and ongoing service maintenance. As an integral part of our global team, you will collaborate closely with DevOps professionals in the U.S. and India, contributing to projects while building your technical expertise in a supportive, growth-oriented environment.
Responsibilities
Collaborate with the global DevOps team to maintain and troubleshoot infrastructure across cloud environments (AWS/GCP).
Learn and implement automation scripts (Python/Bash) to improve operational efficiency.
Support CI/CD pipeline tasks, gaining hands-on experience with tools like Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Monitor application and server health, learning to identify, analyze, and resolve system issues.
Explore the integration of AI tools and concepts into our DevOps workflows.
Maintain and update documentation for systems, processes, and infrastructure.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field (0-1 years of experience)
Foundational knowledge of Linux, Networking, scripting and OS concepts
Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/AZURE)
Understanding of Python

Exposure to AI concepts/tools
Mindset
Strong curiosity and eagerness to learn new technologies and domains
Receptive to feedback and coaching, with a growth-oriented attitude
Collaborative, detail-oriented, and dependable
This role is based in Austin, Texas, and requires to work from the Austin office three days a week.

Ephemeris Net is a pre-seed space networking company on a mission to provide space connectivity for all through collaborative engineering of commercial space networking solutions. We are creating the infrastructure that will enable the space internet beyond bent pipe—starting with foundational networking infrastructure that will define how data moves through space.
We are supported by our parent incubator SOE, preparing to launch our first payload that will demonstrate a space-based router in Q1 2027. While our work will be incremental, we believe that now is the chance to build foundational infrastructure for how the internet will work in space within the next 5 years.
The role
We are looking for engineering interns to work directly on our two core products: optical terminals for space-based laser communications and the networking service that connects satellites into a space network.
By the end of this internship, you will have worked on something that either goes to space (if working on hardware or embedded firmware/software) or pushes forward the technical capability of our internal network and node simulation.
Your specific project will depend on your background and where Ephemeris Net's needs are sharpest when you start. We will match you to a project that is both meaningful to the company and a strong learning opportunity for you.
Example Projects
Upcoming Intern Projects Include
Design and implement optical transceiver FPGA firmware
Build a space network simulator
Design and fabricate test fixtures or mechanical subsystems for optical terminal prototypes or their test fixtures
Build high speed optoelectronic communication test equipment
Write embedded flight software
What You Will Learn
How optical terminals work: from photonics and beam steering to link acquisition and tracking
How space networking differs from terrestrial networking: delay, disruption, orbital dynamics, and protocol design
How to take a technical project from various start stages to end stages: from scoping through implementation to integration with a production system
How to interact with professionals as part of a small, focused engineering team that ships hardware and software for space
Minimum Qualifications
What We Are Looking For
Demonstrated ability to build things: personal projects, research, coursework, or prior internships where you wrote code, designed hardware, or ran experiments that produced tangible results
Strong fundamentals in at least one of: embedded systems and FPGA development, software engineering (C, C++, Python, or Rust), optical or mechanical design, electrical engineering, information theory, or networking and simulation
Ability to work on-site in El Segundo, CA or Oakland, CA for a minimum of 3 months, 3 days a week
Must be a US person (15 CFR
772.1)
Preferred Qualifications
Prior experience with FPGA development (Verilog, VHDL, or SystemVerilog)
Familiarity with optical systems, laser communications, or free-space optics
Experience with network simulation tools or protocol design
Exposure to space systems engineering, orbital mechanics, or flight software
Experience with CAD tools (SolidWorks, NX) or PCB design (Altium, KiCad)
How This Role Works
You will be assigned a mentor who works on the product area closest to your project. You will have regular check-ins and direct access to them for technical guidance.
Before you start, we will meet to understand your strengths and growth goals and come up with a project for you.
You are expected to scope your project, execute, and present your results to the team at the end of the internship.
What We Offer
Compensation & Benefits
Salary: $70,400 annual salary, prorated for length of internship
Comprehensive health care coverage
Work Environment
On-site, 3 days a week minimum: you will work alongside the engineering team in the office and lab. Space hardware development requires hands-on presence.
Small team environment with direct access to founders and senior engineers
Your work will be on production systems, not a side project
The Opportunity
Build something that goes to space: If you work on hardware or embedded systems, your contribution will fly on orbit. If you work on networking, your simulation will inform the architecture of a constellation-scale network.
Work at the frontier of space networking: Ephemeris Net is building infrastructure that does not exist yet, which is rare for greenfield networking work.

Ephemeris Net's vision is to enable an open, space internet that anyone can utilize and access.
We believe that access to better digital connectivity is essential for human progress and that space is the frontier of digital connectivity. We believe that collaboration within market competition is the most effective way to expand the internet into space. Using Ephemeris Net to build space network solutions is how we can proliferate digital connectivity, collaboration, and "the raising of all boats" while achieving a commercial impact.

Access to connectivity for all
Collaboration that raises all boats; we focus on win/win deals

Personal growth and creating a place where people build their careers
Putting good out into the world through the work we do and our interactions with each other

. Pump station evaluation and design.
Water distribution system hydraulic modeling, analysis, and design.

Willingness and ability to occasionally travel to sites in the northeastern US and offices throughout the Northeast.

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.

Basic knowledge of industry-standard computer software for the position. (examples include software such as CADD, HCS, AutoCAD, MicroStation, GIS, and Hydrologic/Hydraulic modeling).
Engineer-in-Training (EIT) or Fundamentals of Engineering (FE).
GIS and CAD skills.
Capable of using spreadsheet, word processing, and standard office software.
Detail-oriented while still able to understand/comply with the big picture/goals of a project.
Ability to multi-task.
Strong logic and writing skills.
Documents time and effort accurately.
Ability to work productively in a team environment.
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Flexible – can adapt to shifting priorities/work schedules.
Able to work independently.
Self-learner.
Can take directions from others and in turn can guide others.

Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.

Hamilton Storage provides automation solutions to customers in life science and clinical research. The company develops modular, scalable systems that automate sample storage, management, and processing. Hamilton provides all the benefits of advanced automation without the complexity associated with installing, operating, and maintaining large-scale custom systems.
Acquired in 2007, Hamilton Storage is headquartered in Franklin, Massachusetts, USA with R&D facilities co-existing in both Franklin, MA and Bonaduz, Switzerland. The decentralized R&D organization benefits both production and marketing and allows Hamilton to stay close to the local markets and respond quickly to market needs.
The Automation Consultant Engineer - Storage (ACES) is a client-facing technical sales consultant and the solution design and workflow optimization expert within the Hamilton Storage commercial organization. Partnering closely with Storage Sales Managers, the ACES translates complex laboratory and biobank workflows into elegant, right-sized Hamilton Storage solutions and builds the technical and business case that advances opportunities to close.
This is a pre-sales and workflow-optimization role—not an implementation or service-delivery role. The ACES designs and sells the solution; installation, commissioning, project execution, and ongoing service are owned by the Service and Project Management teams. The ACES engages before the sale through discovery, solution design, ROI modeling, demonstrations, and RFP response, and after go-live only for consultative workflow optimization that drives expansion and customer advocacy—with no responsibility for service tickets, project delivery, or system commissioning.
Trained in LEAN Six Sigma, the ACES applies continuous-improvement principles to help customers achieve measurable gains in throughput, quality, and operational efficiency. Reporting initially to the VP of Sales and Marketing (subject to organizational change), this role is ideal for a technically rigorous, customer-centric professional who thrives on solving complex problems and building long-term client relationships.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct on-site and virtual workflow discovery sessions to map current-state laboratory and biobank processes, including sample throughput, storage requirements, and integration points.
Apply LEAN Six Sigma principles and structured process mapping to identify inefficiencies, risk points, and automation opportunities within customer workflows.
Facilitate solution-design workshops with customer stakeholders to define requirements and align on a recommended Hamilton Storage solution architecture.
Produce current- and future-state workflow maps and process diagrams using Visio, CAD, or equivalent tools to guide solution configuration.
Build customer-specific ROI and total-cost-of-ownership models in Excel that quantify the operational and financial value of Hamilton Storage automation.
Develop and deliver compelling, audience-tailored presentations that communicate solution value and technical differentiation to both technical and executive stakeholders.
Partner with Storage Sales Managers as the dedicated technical resource across the pre-sales cycle, from opportunity qualification through contract close.
Configure and present Hamilton Storage system options, ensuring proposed solutions are technically accurate, commercially viable, and optimally suited to customer needs.
Lead product and system demonstrations at customer sites and the Hamilton Storage demo facility, differentiating Hamilton Storage from competitive alternatives.
Respond to RFPs and RFIs with technically precise, differentiated content, and equip the sales team with competitive positioning and objection-handling tools.
Maintain deep, current knowledge of the full Hamilton Storage portfolio—hardware, software, consumables, and informatics—including integration with customer LIMS, LIS, and ERP systems.
Provide post-installation workflow optimization through consultative assessment and continuous-improvement recommendations that unlock value and drive expansion, while installation, commissioning, and ongoing service remain with the Service and Project Management teams.
Share customer-facing technical insights with Product Management to inform roadmap priorities, and contribute to sales enablement tools, application notes, and configuration resources.
Represent Hamilton Storage at trade shows, customer events, and technical seminars, and support the development of demo environments.
All other duties as assigned.
Experience in technical consulting, pre-sales engineering, or applications engineering role within laboratory automation, life sciences, or a related technical field.
LEAN Six Sigma training or certification (Green Belt or higher preferred), with demonstrated application of process-improvement methodology.
Proficiency in workflow mapping and diagramming tools (Microsoft Visio, AutoCAD, or equivalent) and advanced Microsoft Excel for building ROI and TCO models.

OKSI is seeking a Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) Engineer to design, develop, and validate GNC algorithms, flight software, and control systems for spacecraft and/or aerial vehicle platforms. The successful candidate will work across the full engineering lifecycle — from algorithm design and simulation through hardware integration, test, and on-orbit or flight operations — collaborating closely with cross-functional engineering teams, program management, and internal and external stakeholders.
What You'll Get To Do
Algorithm & Software Development
Design and develop GNC algorithms for attitude determination and control, orbit determination and control, and precision pointing
Design flight software, algorithms, and simulation products, and support spacecraft autonomy tools for constellation management

Analysis & Simulation

Perform trade studies and recommend optimal GNC configurations, weighing factors such as power, mass, and cost
Run hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), software-in-the-loop (SIL), and Monte Carlo simulations, including iron-bird analysis where applicable
Define fault detection and response strategies for GNC subsystems
Hardware & Systems Integration
Select GNC components and lead GNC subsystem design, including reaction wheels, thrusters, magnetic torquers, IMUs, star trackers, and gyroscopes
Develop blended attitude solutions from multiple sensor data sources
Collaborate with spacecraft, payload, and avionics engineers to define system requirements and ensure GNC compatibility and integration

Develop and execute test plans and procedures for GNC systems, including system-level testing, performance evaluation, and anomaly resolution
Support subscale-to-full-scale test and flight test activities, including travel to support flight test operations as needed
Analyze telemetry data to diagnose and troubleshoot GNC-related anomalies and performance issues
Support on-orbit or in-flight operations and anomaly resolution
Program & Team Collaboration
Support internal and external design reviews
Work with department leads and program managers to plan and maintain schedules, milestones, and technical status reporting
Coordinate with distributed engineering teams across multiple sites
Assist in development of technical proposals and project estimates, and help resolve technical and engineering conflicts
Stay current on industry advancements and emerging technologies in GNC systems, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives

Familiarity with GNC hardware and software components: sensors (gyroscopes, accelerometers, star trackers), actuators, and control algorithms

Prior experience directly interfacing with aerospace customers in the commercial or government sectors
Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with IMUs, reaction wheels, star trackers, gyroscopes, and other GNC hardware

Demonstrated experience developing, implementing, and verifying flight software

NextGen AgTech with In Time Tec builds web and mobile software used to operate feedlots, manage cattle purchasing and transportation, and maintain financial records used by owners and lenders. Our products support yard operations, animal health, billing, financing, logistics, and reporting across web, iOS, and Android.
The testing challenge is consequential: a defect can affect an operator’s books, an animal-health workflow, or a time-sensitive decision in the yard. We are expanding QA capacity while building automation that helps us release faster without accepting greater operational or financial risk.
The role
You will work with developers, product owners, and senior QA staff to find risk early, test new features, and build dependable regression coverage. You will own testing for a defined product area and grow that scope as your product knowledge deepens.
You will not spend all your time following manual scripts. You will exercise judgment through exploratory testing and help move repeatable regression coverage into Playwright and API automation. Senior QA staff are available for mentorship and code review, and we expect you to use them.
What You Will Do
Plan and execute risk-based manual testing for features, integrations, and defect fixes.
Add and maintain automated tests for web, API, and — over time — mobile workflows.
Identify scenarios, edge cases, and acceptance criteria with developers and product managers.
Write clear, reproducible defect reports and verify fixes.
Log, triage, and track defects in the team’s issue-tracking system through resolution.
Validate API behavior, payloads, status codes, and relevant database results.
Run and maintain regression coverage in the CI/CD pipeline.
Review AI-assisted test drafts and generated automation for correctness and missing coverage.
Suggest practical improvements to test coverage, tooling, and the team’s quality process.
What You Would Test
Yard operations, including lots, pens, feed delivery, commodities, animal-health records, and treatments.
Financial workflows, including billing, interest, loans, payments, statements, hedges, and lender-facing reporting.
Purchasing and logistics, including cattle records, hauling, dispatch, and automated notifications.
Customer workflows across web, iOS, and Android in English and Spanish.
What Success Looks Like
In your first 90 days, you own testing for a defined product area, run its regression coverage reliably, and produce defect reports engineers can act on without follow-up.
Within six months, you contribute maintainable Playwright and API tests that pass review, and you shape acceptance criteria and edge cases alongside developers and product managers.
Within one year, you plan and execute testing independently for features in your area, expand automated coverage in CI, and contribute to the team’s testing conventions.
What You Bring
This role requires at least two years of experience in software quality assurance or a related technical role. Relevant internships, co-op assignments, and comparable hands-on experience may count toward this requirement.
A working understanding of test cases, regression, smoke testing, exploratory testing, and black-box versus white-box approaches.
The ability to describe a defect clearly, isolate what happened, and communicate evidence.
Experience with at least one test-automation framework, such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress.
Programming or scripting experience in TypeScript, Python, C#, or a comparable language.
API and SQL knowledge sufficient to validate behavior and data.
Comfort using Git and working within a CI/CD workflow.
A quality-first mindset and genuine comfort asking, “What happens if?”
Helpful, not
required
Mobile application testing or exposure to Appium.
Postman, REST Assured, Cucumber, or Gherkin.
Docker, BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, or similar test environments.
Experience with agriculture, finance, logistics, or another operational domain.
Relevant software-testing or computer-science coursework, bootcamp training, or certification.
Technology

description_preview:
Are you ready to take ownership of critical automation systems in a facility that runs on 99% recycled materials?
Position Summary
We are looking for a driven Project Engineer focused on Level 1 Automation to join our electrical maintenance team in Montpelier, Iowa. This is not a desk job where you only write code in a vacuum. You will be the technical backbone of our rolling mill, taking true ownership of our control systems to ensure safe, reliable, and highly efficient plant operations. Our facility is a modern, high-performing environment that utilizes an electric arc furnace and runs on 99% recycled scrap metal. We are actively investing in our future, and we need someone who is eager to step up, take charge of continuous improvement projects, and help us modernize our legacy hardware and software.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the charge on critical system migrations, specifically upgrading older PLC hardware and I/O platforms to newer, more efficient systems.
Design, modify, and optimize our Level 1 process control systems to maximize production efficiency and product quality.
Write and maintain code for Rockwell PLCs and HMIs to ensure our interfaces are intuitive and our operations run smoothly.
Jump in as a hands-on technical expert during mill breakdowns, working side by side with Operations and Maintenance to troubleshoot issues and get the line running again.
Take long term ownership of new automation systems implemented by outside integrators, ensuring they meet our high standards for reliability.
Qualifications
A Bachelor's degree in Automation, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a closely related field.
1-2+ years of hands-on, real world manufacturing experience working directly with Rockwell PLC and HMI programming.
Specific experience upgrading or migrating legacy control systems and I/O to newer Rockwell platforms.
A proven ability to safely and correctly modify existing PLC ladder logic and HMI code in a live production environment.
A willingness to be fully onsite and a readiness to handle firefighting and troubleshooting directly on the mill floor.
We offer a highly competitive compensation package that includes a strong base salary, a substantial bi-weekly production bonus, and a monthly safety bonus. You will also receive excellent, affordable health insurance starting on day one, a 5% 401(k) match, and profit sharing. We are building the next generation of leadership for our facility. If you are a self starter who wants to make a massive impact and grow your career with a stable, industry leading team, apply today.

title: Oracle Applications Forward Deployed Engineer - GPS
reason: Stack +31; Title fit +6; Poor fit -8; US +10; Overqualified -45
description_preview:
At Deloitte, Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) don't just build AI solutions, they help clients turn AI ambition into enterprise-scale impact, pairing leading class engineering with pod-based delivery and vertical expertise. If you thrive at the intersection of product, engineering, problem-solving, and client impact, this role puts you at the forefront of AI transformations.
Work you'll do
As a Senior Oracle Applications FDE, you will work side by side with senior functional and technical client team members to rapidly prototype and deliver high-impact GenAI-enabled solutions. This requires a highly motivated practitioner who moves with speed and precision, building working software, engaging confidently with senior stakeholders and engineers to bring measurable business impact from day one. Additional responsibilities include:
Client Engagement
Embed with clients to identify business needs and translate high-value GenAI use cases into solutions.
Partner with leaders, product owners, architects, and engineers to align priorities and delivery.
Lead working sessions to shape solutions and drive client outcomes.
Identify opportunities to redesign business processes using AI and automation, driving measurable improvements in productivity, compliance, cycle time, operational risk, and workforce efficiency.
Prototype and deliver working AI solutions using industry expertise and emerging capabilities.
Contribute independently within an FDE pod while strengthening team and organizational impact by mentoring other FDEs through design/code reviews and feedback, while contributing reusable components to intellectual capital.
Coach client teams and end users on platform capabilities and AI enablement, while building trusted relationships, managing expectations, and supporting long-term engagement success.
Drive end-to-end sales and delivery support by developing demos/POCs, contributing to proposals and orals, articulating business value, and documenting solutions for smooth client handoff and knowledge transfer.
Solution Engineering
Build and orchestrate multi-agent systems that coordinate across HR, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, and shared-services business domains.
Develop scalable AI engineering patterns, tool-use approaches, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Apply architecture decisions that balance quality, safety, latency, cost, and model risk.
Deliver production-quality code using strong practices in testing, CI/CD, logging, versioning, and documentation.
Design extensible functionality, support sprint sizing, and align solutions with senior team members.
Contribute reusable assets including code, prompt libraries, runbooks, and reference implementations.
Design and implement AI agents that securely retrieve information, reason across enterprise data, and execute actions within Oracle ERP, HCM, EBS, PeopleSoft, and adjacent enterprise applications.
A successful candidate would possess these skills:
Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others
The team
Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.
Our AI & Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.
Qualifications
Required:
Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Science or Engineering.
4+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, data science, or analytics engineering.
1+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI/LLM-powered solutions in client or production environments
2+ years of experience extending and integrating Oracle Fusion Applications, Oracle EBS, and PeopleSoft through Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, Business Events, Visual Builder, Process Automation, and custom application services.
2+ years of experience with Oracle, including hands-on experience with one of the following key technologies:
Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio and Fusion Application Extensibility Frameworks for building, customizing, and governing AI agents inside ERP and HCM workflows.
OCI Generative AI Agents / Enterprise AI for building enterprise-grade agents supporting finance, procurement, supply chain, HR, payroll, recruiting, and shared services use cases.
OCI Generative AI Service, including RAG, function calling, tool use, enterprise memory, and orchestration of multi-step business processes.
AI-native Oracle Fusion Applications capabilities across ERP, HCM, SCM, and EPM, including intelligent approvals, anomaly detection, forecasting, narrative generation, workforce planning, and embedded copilots.
1 + years of experience translating business processes into AI agents, agentic workflows, and autonomous operations.
1+ years of experience developing semantic models, knowledge graphs, ontologies, enterprise taxonomies, vectorized knowledge repositories, and business-context layers supporting ERP and HCM AI solutions.
1+ years of experience leading project workstreams/engagements and translating business problems into AI solutions
1+ years of experience building reliable, mainta
